questions: Before updating, what sign should each mean weight gradient have?
Why does temperature-only training classify the warm, low-vibration example as positive?
Can changing the decision threshold correct both correlation-breaking errors without changing the learned ranking?
Does a lower training loss certify behavior on measurements unlike these examples?
limitations: The labels and sensor readings are authored synthetic teaching data, not observed equipment measurements or safety thresholds.
Normalization and updates use training data only. Repeatedly selecting settings after viewing the held-out examples turns them into development feedback, not an untouched test of generalization.
The decision threshold changes confusion counts without changing fitted parameters or cross-entropy. A low training loss does not prove useful behavior on shifted cases.
Temperature and vibration correlate in training; deliberately separated evaluation cases expose reliance on that correlation. This is an illustration, not causal identification.
Precision/recall/false-positive rates with a zero denominator are null, not silently scored as zero or one.
Quality and latency gates are separate, explicitly selected teaching constraints. No real application or vendor performance claim is made.

limitations: All reference facts describe a fictional manual; they are not real equipment specifications.
This is TF–IDF retrieval plus deterministic sentence selection, not a language model or a benchmark of general question answering.
Index fitting uses documents; threshold calibration uses only tuning queries. Repeatedly choosing settings after seeing held-out results makes those queries development feedback.
A citation can exactly support a copied sentence while that sentence answers the wrong entity or attribute. Such a response fails task correctness even with sourceSupportAmongAnswers = 1.
Exact support checks establish agreement with this closed corpus and fact schema, not truth in the world or semantic support for arbitrary generated prose.
The slot parser chooses the first named entity and narrow keywords. It deliberately does not solve negation, reference, paraphrase or competing entities.
Quality, abstention and hypothetical latency/payload estimates have separate denominators and assumptions. No vendor timing or broad capability claim is made.
